Were they part of Chinese texts on matters astronomical or were they in the context of other matters ? I also note that even though they looked into texts from other cultures the only examples mentioned were Chinese.

All that being said I wouldn't be shocked to find that telescope- like devices were used in China prior to Galileo. Sighting tubes were apparently used from ancient times in China. Using one of these and either some sort of filter like we use to view eclipses or the old 'pinhole camera' trick it seems reasonable to me that sunspots could be observed.
